---
title: "Check the inputs"
---

From the repo root, check the example first.

```bash
python3 scripts/python/verify_inputs.py data/metagenomics/example
```

## Your task — Check your own files

```bash
python3 scripts/python/verify_inputs.py data/metagenomics/my-study
```

Resolve reported problems before continuing. The runner repeats these checks before writing results.
